en.abdullah-al-shahin: (44) Abu Sulayman Ahmad bin Hawtha narrated from Ibraheem bin Iss’haq an-Nahawandi from Abdullah bin Hammad al-Ansari from Ali bin Abu Hamza that Abu Abdullah as-Sadiq (as) had said:
“When al-Qa’im (as) rises, the angels of Badr will descend. They are five thousand angels. A third of them will be on gray horses, a third on piebald horses and a third on red horses.”
